description: The Maharashtra Resilient Development Programme (MRDP), designed to enhance the state’s disaster management system, will receive Rs 165 crore in external assistance from the World Bank.
body_lead: The Maharashtra Resilient Development Programme (MRDP), designed to enhance the state’s disaster management system, will receive Rs 165 crore in external assistance from the World Bank. Mumbai: The Maharashtra Cabinet on Tuesday approved the creation of a new Information Technology and Artificial Intelligence department, a major restructuring of state power utility Mahavitaran, and a World Bank-supported programme aimed at strengthening disaster-response mechanisms.
